summary: Quote- and escape-aware lexer for delimited text. Handles logical record splitting, comment-record removal and field tokenisation, and encodes each field in the first form that cannot be misread in its position, working right to left through the record.
documentation_hooks: Maintainer note: CSV lexer path vs native pyarrow path
risks: The lexer is a pure-Python character loop and is the slow path for large non-native CSV input.
The CSV tests exercise it only through csv_parse and csv_serialise; it has no direct unit tests.
